x: In the Talbot Games 100 metres at Crystal Palace on June 27th Ernest was outgunned by the UK sprinters, even though he ran 10.57. Wells (10.30), Sharp (10.43) and Hoyte (10.54) were up ahead but our man had the satisfaction of keeping well clear of 1976 Olympic Champion Haseley Crawford of Trinidad (10.62).

Almost all of our senior Club Records were under threat and several fell; with John Regis taking Ernest's 200m time, John Gladwin bettering his own 800m time, Ken O extended his discus record and Gary Staines became our first sub 4 minute miler.
A highlight of this years BAL matches has been the sprints and relays with Todd Bennett turning out for Southampton and Ernest for Belgrave.
We were again hit by having no sprinters to back Lenny - with Phil, Ernest and Mike Bazire injured and John and Marcus competing elsewhere. John Gladwin again won the 800 in a magnificent 1:48.21.
